purpose: measure construction validity, serialization, eigensolver cost, and local low-band rank for one real prompt before any multi-prompt or outcome-bearing run
claim_boundary: A pass authorizes only a multi-prompt prereveal engineering run. One prompt cannot establish cross-prompt bundle stability, policy utility, direct-edit utility, self-improvement, or RSI.

gates.B0_bundle_integrity: CSR bundle reloads at its sealed hash with one exact registered edit-space layout and no missing/reused/unreferenced arrays
gates.N0_naturality: JSpace v1.0.4 exact incidence universe passes from sealed naturality maps
gates.R0_reliability: at least two registered norm strata pass JSpace R0
gates.M0_matrix_free_cost: run completes inside registered caps without swap, timeout, cleanup failure, or dense d-by-d mean-projector materialization
gates.E0_low_band_solver: seeded sparse eigensolver returns finite residuals and a reproducible low-band rank; rank is descriptive and has no minimum pass threshold

next_step_if_passed: register at least five independent multi-prompt operators, seal geometry before outcomes, then run grouped policy/edit prediction gates
